case.title: Expired/used link
case.variant: Replay of the same recovery email link already consumed by the successful AU04.02 view; expiry variant remains separate
case.link_source: Reset password in the same recovery email already successfully used; never share or persist its URL
case.browser_context: Keep the original verified password-form tab open. Open the original email link once in a separate private tab; copy/paste privately there if required. Do not replace, refresh or duplicate the verified tab.
case.expected_message: This link or session is unavailable. Open the newest email or request another link.
owner_return_fields: Displayed message or screenshot of the replay result
case.if_password_fields_or_verified_identity_: Stop and report that observation without entering or saving any password. Do not infer replay denial.
case.if_other_error_appears: Report the exact safe page message; do not retry or request another email.
case.cleanup: After reporting, close only the replay/error tabs. Retain the original verified password-form tab for later controlled steps.

source_review: createLinkController rejects callback errors or otp_expired without using an existing stored session. Password fields remain hidden until actual link verification succeeds. Existing controller cases cover callback errors and expired token-hash denial; the real provider replay result is pending.
replay_HTTP_or_session_effect_not_assume: One manual replay can make several provider/redirect/Auth requests. Counts, denial and preservation of the original recovery session must not be inferred from local source alone.
later_password_save_readiness: Before actual password save/verification/continuation, confirm controlled gateway-code recipient and bounded application-window readiness; neither action is part of this replay check.
